lines.x: Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited approved annual financial statements for FY2026, delivering a record profit before tax of Rs34.6 billion and recommending a final cash dividend of Rs3.00 per share.

Pakistan's National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) revised the special industrial electricity tariff upward to Rs25.30 per unit despite internal dissent, alongside an additional fuel cost adjustment charge.

A group of U.S. companies, including Global Vision Energy Partners and Khanjee Holdings with support from the Trump Administration, proposed a $4.4 billion LNG import and storage terminal in Pakistan amid high gas import costs.
Pakistan will auction 90% of its indigenous liquefied petroleum gas production under a new deregulated framework aimed at promoting competitive bidding and transparency in fuel distribution.
